settings.title: Settings
settings.hostname_helper: SMTP banner, EHLO name and TLS certificate name. Its DNS A record and the reverse record of the node address should match it
settings.lets_encrypt_tooltip: Request a Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name (and the metrics host name). The DNS record must point to this node. Until then a self-signed certificate is used
settings.inbound_tooltip: Accepts mail for the inbound domains from anyone, and relaying from trusted networks and authenticated clients. Disable it to run as an outbound-only relay next to another mail server
settings.submission_tooltip: Clients authenticate with SMTP AUTH after STARTTLS. Use a non-standard port when another mail server of the node owns 587
settings.relay_networks_helper: IP addresses or CIDR networks, one per line: their clients relay without authentication. Loopback is always trusted
settings.cluster_relay: Offer as smarthost to the cluster (cluster relay)
settings.cluster_relay_tooltip: On by default. Trusts the cluster network for relaying without authentication and publishes the submission service, so that the cluster Email notifications settings and other applications can use this MTA as their relay. Turn it off to stop trusting the cluster network and withdraw the service
settings.cluster_relay_needs_port_25: The cluster smarthost needs the inbound listener on port 25
settings.cluster_relay_needs_port_25_description: NethServer configures an application smarthost with port 25 and no authentication: the service is not published while the inbound listener is disabled or on another port
settings.cluster_relay_active_description: Relaying is open to the cluster network {network}; applications use {address}, port 25
settings.metrics_description: Optional: publish /metrics of KumoMTA through Traefik, protected by HTTP basic authentication of the user 'metrics'. The administration API is never published
settings.metrics_allowlist_helper: Optional. One IP address or CIDR network per line
settings.mail_modules_on_node: Other mail modules on this node
settings.mail_modules_on_node_description: {modules}: their mail ports cannot be used. Disable the inbound listener and choose another submission port to run as an outbound relay next to them
settings.cluster_relay_off_description: The cluster network is not trusted and the submission service is not published: the cluster Email notifications settings no longer list this MTA. Applications must authenticate with an SMTP user or come from a trusted network
settings.implicit_tls_tooltip: Not available yet: KumoMTA added implicit TLS listeners (tls_mode = ImplicitTls) in October 2026, after its newest stable release 2026.09.29. It will be offered once a stable KumoMTA release includes it. Use the submission listener with STARTTLS meanwhile
settings.sink_tooltip: KumoMTA accepts every message and discards it instead of delivering it, and logs a Delivery record. Recipients whose local part contains tempfail or permfail simulate a deferral or a bounce. Never use it in production
settings.sink_description: While sink mode is on, no message leaves this server: outbound mail, relayed inbound mail and the queued messages are accepted and discarded

action.copy-openbao-to-local: Copy OpenBao secrets to local storage
action.list-openbao-only-secrets: List the secrets stored only in OpenBao

users.title: SMTP users
users.description: Credentials of the clients that submit mail with SMTP AUTH (after STARTTLS). Passwords are stored as salted hashes and never shown again.

domains.title: Domains
domains.sending_description: Messages from trusted clients with a From address of these domains are signed with DKIM. Publish the TXT record in the DNS of the domain.
domains.rotate_confirm: A new key replaces the current one: publish the new TXT record at once. Continue?
domains.key_local_not_in_openbao: Local key, not yet in OpenBao
domains.dkim_in_openbao: DKIM keys are read from OpenBao
domains.dkim_in_openbao_description: Generate the key of a new domain, or move a local key, to store it in OpenBao: it then leaves the volume of the module
domains.inbound_description: Mail for these domains is accepted from anyone and relayed to the given server, for example the internal mail server.
domains.remove_api_confirm: Remove {domain}, added by the integration {owner}? Its DKIM key is deleted

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.smarthost_description: Optional: relay every outgoing message through another server instead of delivering directly to the destination MX.
delivery.secret_in_openbao: Stored in OpenBao: write it to replace the current value
delivery.shaping_description: Limits per destination domain, over the default KumoMTA shaping rules. Rate examples: 100/min, 1000/h.
delivery.webhook_description: Optional: KumoMTA posts each selected log record as JSON to the URL.
delivery.webhook_signing_secret_helper: Optional, at least 16 characters: each request carries X-KumoMTA-Signature, an HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp and the body. See docs/webhooks.md

openbao.title: OpenBao
openbao.description: Optional: read the secrets of KumoMTA (DKIM private keys, smarthost password, webhook token) from OpenBao or Vault (KV version 2) instead of local files. The address and the token are stored in a file readable only by the module, and never written in the KumoMTA policy.
openbao.enabled_tooltip: KumoMTA reads VAULT_ADDR and VAULT_TOKEN from its environment. Secrets live under <mount>/<path>/dkim/<domain>/<selector>, <path>/smarthost and <path>/webhook
openbao.token_helper: Write only: the token is never shown again. It needs read access to the path, and write access to store the secrets from this page
openbao.key_helper: Field of each secret, empty for the default 'key'
openbao.disable_warning_title: These secrets exist only in OpenBao
openbao.disable_warning_description: Without OpenBao, KumoMTA cannot read them: the DKIM keys stop signing (messages leave unsigned) and the smarthost password and webhook token stop working until they are set again
openbao.not_readable: Not readable with the current token
openbao.copy_description: Copy them to the local storage first: they are written to files readable only by the module, then OpenBao is turned off.
openbao.copy_impossible: The current token cannot read every secret
openbao.copy_impossible_description: Copying to the local storage is not possible. Turn OpenBao off anyway, or cancel and fix the token first
openbao.copy_and_disable: Copy to local storage and turn off
openbao.items_unavailable_title: Some secrets were left in OpenBao
openbao.items_unavailable_description: No longer available to KumoMTA: {items}. Generate or set them again

queue.title: Queue
queue.not_running_description: Configure the module, then check its service on the Status page
queue.recent_events_helper: From the KumoMTA logs: a log segment closes every minute

validation.no_listener_enabled: Enable at least one SMTP listener
validation.same_port_as_inbound: Same port as the inbound listener
validation.mail_module_on_node: Port used by another mail module of the node
validation.smarthost_loop: The smarthost cannot be this server
validation.domain_already_used_in_traefik: Host name already used in Traefik
validation.openbao_write_failed: Cannot write the secret to OpenBao
validation.invalid_integration_name: Invalid name: 3-32 lowercase letters, digits and dashes, not ns8-admin or metrics
validation.name_used_by_smtp_user: An SMTP user has the same name
validation.api_port_missing: The module has no second TCP port: update it

warnings.sink_mode_title: Sink mode is on: no mail is delivered
warnings.sink_mode_description: KumoMTA accepts and discards every outbound message (testing mode). Turn it off in Settings to deliver mail again

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.api_description: Sending platforms inject mail over HTTP (KumoMTA /api/inject/v1) and manage their sending domains (/api/v1/domains) with an integration credential, through Traefik and HTTPS. The admin API of the module is never exposed. SMTP submission with the credential works too.
integrations.api_host_helper: Empty disables the HTTPS routes. The DNS name must point to this node; Let's Encrypt follows the Settings page
integrations.api_allowlist_helper: Optional. One IP address or CIDR network per line
integrations.require_verified_domains: Integrations send only from verified domains
integrations.require_verified_domains_tooltip: An integration can send only From a sending domain it added, or one of the administrator, whose DNS records are validated. Turn it off for tests only
integrations.spf_include_helper: Mechanism the customers add to their SPF record, e.g. include:_spf.example.org. Empty for a:<host name>
integrations.bounce_domain_helper: Optional. Its MX must point to this server: bounces and feedback-loop reports sent to it, or to bounces.<customer domain> (CNAME to it), are logged as OOB and Feedback records and sent to the webhook
integrations.credentials_description: One credential per sending platform, separate from the admin API user of the module. HTTP basic authentication for the API, SMTP AUTH for submission.
integrations.name: Name (user name)
integrations.tenant_helper: Optional: forced on its messages. Empty lets X-Tenant choose
integrations.password_helper: Write only, at least 16 characters. The module stores a salted hash
integrations.copy_password_now_description: It is shown only here, before saving: the module keeps only a hash
